overview_description.description:
The heart of their business is off-post military housing. Military installations are dynamic economic engines for adjacent communities. The most important military installations will continue to create jobs and economic prosperity for nearby communities for the foreseeable future. Not only do these communities provide support for those serving their country, they also offer opportunities to real estate investors looking for dependable returns and attractive growth.
 
 Accend’s business model is sustainable because military communities are characterized by the continual mobility of a large segment of their population. The tenants they target desire a broader range of rental choices and services than are currently available to them. They value a combination of quality, flexibility, and convenience at an affordable price. They are passionate about their residents and work hard to meet their needs.
 
 Accend invests from the perspective that their portfolio should provide strong returns at any stage of investment. Although no investment is without risk, their business and investment strategies are designed to strike an optimal balance between real estate investment risk and reward. They only acquire fundamentally sound multifamily assets in markets that have continual demand from prospective tenants. Because they design and provide value-added rental products and services that cater to their communities, they are able to satisfy their special requirements and create additional value for their investors.
 
 Accend plans to be a trusted brand name in the off-post military housing sector for years to come. Please contact us to learn more about how you can allocate a portion of your investment portfolio with us.
